_comment: Generous starting budgets per Prompt 2 — the point right now is having the harness in place with a recorded baseline, not hitting a final target on a near-empty app. Tighten these as the app grows and re-baseline in later prompts as directed.

bundleSize._note: Near-empty app currently baselines around ~550KB (React + Next.js runtime chunks only). Budget set generously above that per Prompt 2's notes; tighten as real app code is added.

render3d._note: 33.3ms = 30fps floor. Re-pointed at the real Game Room scene in Prompt 19; baseline there is 16.7ms (vsync-capped 60fps) with GPU rendering. Headless software rendering (SwiftShader, the fallback on GPU-less machines) measures ~60ms for the same scene — run on a GPU machine for meaningful numbers.

realtimeLoad._reconnectNote: Prompt 17. Dominated by realtime-js's own first reconnect backoff step (~1s by default) plus socket reopen, channel rejoin, presence re-track, and a confirmatory broadcast round trip in both directions — generous starting budget per the same rationale as the rest of this file.
